extraction_notes: The datasheet identifies the device as an N-channel MOSFET and gives revision Rev:1.0.

Fig. 1 output characteristics are pulsed at Ta = 25 degC. Separate digitized traces are provided for VGS = 3 V, 4 V, and 5 V; the higher VGS traces overlap near the upper plot limit and were not assigned separate points.
Fig. 2 transfer characteristics are pulsed at Ta = 25 degC. The figure does not state VDS, so no VDS condition was assigned.

Fig. 7 capacitance traces were digitized on logarithmic VDS and capacitance axes. The figure does not state VGS or test frequency; the dynamic table gives the separate capacitance test condition VDS = 25 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz.
The VSD table entry is 0.55 V minimum and 1.2 V maximum at IS = 115 mA, VGS = 0 V. The body_diode spec uses a typical Fig. 6 reading of approximately 0.74 V at 115 mA.

Additional transcribed table fields: IDSS maximum 80 nA at VDS = 60 V, VGS = 0 V; IGSS maximum plus or minus 100 nA at VDS = 0 V, VGS = plus or minus 20 V; ID(ON) minimum 500 mA at VGS = 10 V, VDS = 7 V; VDS(ON) maximum 3.75 V at VGS = 10 V, ID = 500 mA and 0.375 V at VGS = 5 V, ID = 50 mA; gfs minimum 80 mS at VDS = 10 V, ID = 115 mA.
Switching table fields: td(on) maximum 20 ns and td(off) maximum 40 ns, with VDD = 25 V, RL = 50 ohm, VGEN = 10 V, ID = 500 mA, and RGEN = 25 ohm.
Maximum ratings include VDS = 60 V, VGS = plus or minus 20 V, ID = 115 mA, IDM = 800 mA, PD = 200 mW, RthetaJA = 357 K/W on the specified FR-4 board, and TJ/TSTG = -55 to +150 degC.
